EDA-13Unauthenticated Admin API Endpoints
Assetapi/proxy/server/routing.go
StatusResolved: See Resolution
RatingInformational
<|det|>title [68, 256, 178, 273]<|/det|>Description <|det|>text [66, 295, 930, 325]<|/det|>The admin API endpoints are exposed without any authentication mechanism, allowing unauthorised access to administrative functionality that can modify the EigenDA dispersal backend configuration. <|det|>text [67, 338, 714, 353]<|/det|>The code in routing.go registers admin endpoints without authentication middleware: <|det|>text [73, 363, 553, 472]<|/det|>api/proxy/server/routing.go if svr.config.ISAPIEnabled(AdminAPIType) { svr.log.warn("Admin API endpoints are enabled") // Admin endpoints to check and set EigenDA backend used for dispersal r.handleFunc("/admin/ testified-dispersal-backend", newAnteEngineId(DispersalBackend).Method("") r.handleFunc("/admin/eigenda-dispersal-backend", svr.handleSetEigenDADispersalBackend).Methods("PUT") } <|det|>text [66, 481, 931, 525]<|/det|>The comment at lines \( [22-124] \) acknowledges this as a known issue but dismisses it based on the assumption that the proxy is not meant to be exposed publicly. However, this creates a security risk where unauthorised users can read and modify the EigenDA dispersal backend configuration through the /admin/eigenda-dispersal-backend endpoints. <|det|>title [68, 557, 238, 572]<|/det|>Recommendations <|det|>text [67, 597, 506, 612]<|/det|>Implement authentication middleware for admin endpoints. <|det|>title [68, 646, 168, 661]<|/det|>Resolution <|det|>text [67, 685, 921, 700]<|/det|>The development team were aware of the issue and noted this is highlighted in the documentation in Admin Routes. <|det|>footer [75, 925, 205, 945]<|/det|>signalprime <|det|>page_number [810, 931, 881, 945]<|/det|>Page | 25
